contribution: Applies split conformal prediction to LLM option probabilities on MMLU and shows set size tracks uncertainty and accuracy.

title: Conformal Language Modeling

title: Conformalizing Machine Translation Evaluation
contribution: Applies conformal prediction to MT quality metrics to obtain calibrated confidence intervals and exposes conditional coverage gaps.

title: Selective Generation for Controllable Language Models

title: TRAQ: Trustworthy Retrieval Augmented Question Answering via Conformal Prediction
contribution: TRAQ: conformalises both retriever and generator and aggregates them for end-to-end coverage in retrieval-augmented QA.

title: Conformal Autoregressive Generation: Beam Search with Coverage Guarantees

title: Conformal Temporal Logic Planning using Large Language Models
contribution: Pairs a symbolic LTL planner with an LLM action planner that uses conformal prediction to request help, guaranteeing mission success rates.

title: Prompt Risk Control: A Rigorous Framework for Responsible Deployment of Large Language Models
contribution: Selects prompts with high-probability upper bounds on risk measures such as VaR, CVaR and dispersion across users.

contribution: Benchmarks LLMs with conformal prediction set size alongside accuracy, showing higher accuracy can pair with higher uncertainty.

title: C-RAG: Certified Generation Risks for Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
contribution: C-RAG: certifies conformal generation-risk bounds for RAG configurations and proves retrieval can lower risk.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Evaluation for Vision-Language Models
contribution: Benchmarks 20+ VLMs on multiple-choice VQA using conformal set size as the uncertainty measure.

contribution: S-ATLAS: distributed LLM multi-robot planner that asks for help when conformal sets are ambiguous, achieving user-set mission success.

title: Explore until Confident: Efficient Exploration for Embodied Question Answering
contribution: Uses multi-step conformal prediction on VLM answers to decide when an exploring robot is confident enough to stop and answer.

title: API Is Enough: Conformal Prediction for Large Language Models Without Logit-Access
contribution: Builds nonconformity scores from sample frequency plus semantic similarity so conformal sets work with API-only LLMs.

title: Mitigating LLM Hallucinations via Conformal Abstention
contribution: Calibrates a self-consistency abstention threshold with conformal prediction to bound the hallucination rate of answered questions.

title: Conformal Alignment: Knowing When to Trust Foundation Models with Guarantees
contribution: Trains an alignment predictor and applies conformal selection so outputs certified as trustworthy satisfy FDR control.

title: Fast yet Safe: Early-Exiting with Risk Control
contribution: Adapts risk-control frameworks to early-exit networks, including CALM summarisation, trading compute for guaranteed quality.

title: Large language model validity via enhanced conformal prediction methods
contribution: Adds conditional validity and level-adaptive calibration to claim filtering so more claims survive while factuality stays guaranteed.

title: ConU: Conformal Uncertainty in Large Language Models with Correctness Coverage Guarantees
contribution: ConU: turns sampling self-consistency into a conformal score for open-ended QA and guarantees correctness coverage of answer sets.

title: Trust or Escalate: LLM Judges with Provable Guarantees for Human Agreement
contribution: Escalates from weak to strong LLM judges only when calibrated confidence is low, guaranteeing a target human-agreement rate.

title: Multi-group Uncertainty Quantification for Long-form Text Generation
contribution: Adds multicalibration and multivalid conformal prediction so claim-level and response-level coverage hold across subgroups.

title: Conformal Generative Modeling with Improved Sample Efficiency through Sequential Greedy Filtering
contribution: SCOPE-Gen: sequential greedy filtering with conformal control so a prediction set of generations contains an admissible one.

title: Sample then Identify: A General Framework for Risk Control and Assessment in Multimodal Large Language Models
contribution: TRON: calibrates how many responses to sample, then identifies high-quality ones, giving risk-controlled answer sets for multimodal LLMs.

contribution: Represents conformal sets implicitly as structured objects (e.g. DAG nodes) to keep them interpretable while retaining marginal or PAC coverage.

title: Addressing Uncertainty in LLMs to Enhance Reliability in Generative AI
contribution: Uses likelihood of dynamic semantic clusters as the conformity score to output sets of responses with coverage guarantees.

title: Conformal Tail Risk Control for Large Language Model Alignment
contribution: Controls distortion risk measures such as CVaR of LLM output disutility via conformal calibration of sample-and-filter.

title: Conformal Linguistic Calibration: Trading-off between Factuality and Specificity
contribution: Replaces claim deletion with rewriting to less specific but more likely true claims, trading specificity for guaranteed factuality.

title: Learning Conformal Abstention Policies for Adaptive Risk Management in Large Language and Vision-Language Models
contribution: Learns conformal thresholds with reinforcement learning to trade coverage, set size and abstention for LLMs and VLMs.

title: An Empirical Study of Conformal Prediction in LLM with ASP Scaffolds for Robust Reasoning
contribution: Applies conformal language modeling to sets of LLM-generated ASP programs for multi-step spatial reasoning.

title: Correctness Coverage Evaluation for Medical Multiple-Choice Question Answering Based on the Enhanced Conformal Prediction Framework
contribution: Frequency-based conformal sets with a monotone-loss risk control step for medical MCQA.

title: Conformal Prediction Sets for Deep Generative Models via Reduction to Conformal Regression
contribution: GPS: reduces generative prediction sets to conformal regression on the number of samples needed for an admissible output.

title: ConformalNL2LTL: Translating Natural Language Instructions into Temporal Logic Formulas with Conformal Correctness Guarantees
contribution: Builds LTL formulas via sequential LLM QA with conformal sets, deferring to an auxiliary model or user to meet a translation success rate.

title: SConU: Selective Conformal Uncertainty in Large Language Models
contribution: SConU: uses conformal p-values to reject outlier questions before building sets, keeping miscoverage control on retained samples.

title: SafePath: Conformal Prediction for Safe LLM-Based Autonomous Navigation
contribution: SafePath: conformal sets over LLM-generated driving paths, delegating to a human when the set is ambiguous.

title: Conformal Language Model Reasoning with Coherent Factuality
contribution: Filters reasoning claims over a deducibility graph so conformal factuality holds while keeping the remaining chain coherent.

title: Response Quality Assessment for Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Conditional Conformal Factuality
contribution: Group-conditional conformal factuality filtering of RAG responses to meet target factuality levels.

title: Online Conformal Abstention for Factuality Control Under Adversarial Bandit Feedback
contribution: Extends conformal abstention to online, adversarial bandit feedback, controlling hallucination FDR without a fixed calibration set.

title: Conformal Prediction Beyond the Seen: A Missing Mass Perspective for Uncertainty Quantification in Generative Models
contribution: CPQ: conformal prediction from finite queries to a black-box generator, using missing-mass estimates to trade coverage, queries and informativeness.

title: Conformal Arbitrage: Risk-Controlled Balancing of Competing Objectives in Language Models
contribution: Calibrates a switch between a primary and guardian LLM so a secondary objective is risk-controlled while the primary objective is maximised.

title: Conformal Information Pursuit for Interactively Guiding Large Language Models
contribution: Uses conformal set size as a proxy for conditional entropy to choose the next question in interactive LLM information pursuit.

title: Conformal Sets in Multiple-Choice Question Answering under Black-Box Settings with Provable Coverage Guarantees
contribution: Frequency-based nonconformity scores for black-box MCQA conformal sets with provable coverage on MMLU and MMLU-Pro.

title: Conformal P-Value in Multiple-Choice Question Answering Tasks with Provable Risk Control
contribution: Builds MCQA prediction sets via hypothesis tests on self-consistency p-values with miscoverage control.

title: Document Summarization with Conformal Importance Guarantees
contribution: Calibrates sentence-importance thresholds so extractive summaries retain important content at a user-set coverage.

title: Analyzing Uncertainty of LLM-as-a-Judge: Interval Evaluations with Conformal Prediction
contribution: Wraps LLM-as-a-judge ratings in conformal prediction intervals and adds boundary adjustment for discrete rating scales.

title: Reliable Inference in Edge-Cloud Model Cascades via Conformal Alignment
contribution: Casts edge-to-cloud escalation as multiple testing so edge prediction sets meet cloud-level conditional coverage.

title: SAFER: Risk-Constrained Sample-then-Filter in Large Language Models
contribution: SAFER: bounds the sampling budget with Clopper-Pearson calibration, abstains beyond it, then filters unreliable candidates under a risk constraint.

title: Conformal Thinking: Risk Control for Reasoning on a Compute Budget
contribution: Calibrates upper and lower early-stopping thresholds on reasoning confidence to control error and wasted compute.

title: CommCP: Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination via LLM-Based Communication with Conformal Prediction
contribution: CommCP: calibrates LLM-generated inter-robot messages with conformal prediction for multi-agent embodied QA.

title: CORA: Conformal Risk-Controlled Agents for Safeguarded Mobile GUI Automation
contribution: CORA: post-policy, pre-action safeguard for mobile GUI agents that bounds harmful executed actions with conformal risk control.

title: Conformal Language Modeling via Posterior Sampling
contribution: Samples from a calibrated approximate posterior instead of post-hoc claim removal, achieving risk control with more coherent outputs.
